description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

- New: YouTube player controls. Double-tap left/right to skip 10 s, hold for 2x speed, and a settings button (top right) for speed and captions. Setting: Captions on by default.
- New: Fix share links. Reddit share links (reddit.com/r/…/s/…) open directly in rif, in-app and from other apps; Back works normally.
- Fix: a video in an imgur album now plays inline in post bodies.
